arguments.script: System.Collections.IEnumerator Check(){float previous=UnityEngine.Time.timeScale; UnityEngine.Time.timeScale=0; UnityEngine.GameObject probe=null; try{ probe=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Temporary impact audio probe"); var contact=probe.AddComponent<Character.ContactSoundEffect>(); yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForSecondsRealtime(.3f); var router=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>(); int count=router==null?0:router.PlayCount; if(contact.TryPlayImpact(.1f) || contact.TryPlayImpact(2.19f))throw new System.Exception("Light hammer hit played"); if(router!=null && router.PlayCount!=count)throw new System.Exception("Silent hit advanced audio"); if(!contact.TryPlayImpact(4f))throw new System.Exception("Strong hammer hit silent"); if(contact.TryPlayImpact(5f))throw new System.Exception("Cooldown not enforced"); router=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>(); string last=router.LastClipName; if(last==null || !last.StartsWith("footstep_grass_"))throw new System.Exception("Wrong hammer material"); var seen=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(); seen.Add(last); for(int i=0;i<12;i++){yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForSecondsRealtime(.17f); GameplayAudio.Play(i%2==0?"body_hit":"hammer_hit",.02f); string current=router.LastClipName;if(current==null || !current.StartsWith("footstep_grass_") || current==last)throw new System.Exception("Variant/repeat error");seen.Add(current);last=current;} foreach(var source in router.GetComponents<UnityEngine.AudioSource>())if(source.pitch!=1f || UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(source.volume-GameplayAudio.Gain)>.001f)throw new System.Exception("Pitch/gain incorrect"); UnityEngine.Debug.Log("IMPACT_GRASS_PLAY_PASS: light hits silent,strong hit plays grass,cooldown,13 plays without immediate repeat,variantsSeen="+seen.Count+",pitch1,preference gain.");}finally{if(probe!=null)UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(probe);UnityEngine.Time.timeScale=previous;}} return Check();
arguments.summary: Test light-hit silence, heavy hammer playback, cooldown and grass variations without writing preferences
